## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Sources are verified at source (the document, publisher, repository or Crossref), with the link given
- [ ] Statements about what an author says carry a page number, or a section for unpaginated web pages
- [ ] Quotations are word for word
- [ ] Bibliography changes were made in `build_bibliography.py` and the script was rerun
- [ ] Lesson or card changes were checked in a browser at phone and desktop width
- [ ] Plain, direct sentences
- [ ] Nothing confidential, private or not publicly available
